incident-bot: Pager fired: service=inference-api severity=page type=p99-latency region=us-east-2 — triggered 1782345679
alex: acked (oncall). i'm taking it. :eyes:
alex: initial metrics: p95=420ms p99=1.32s qps=3.2k backend-error-rate=0.1%
maya: seeing a concurrent spike in kv-read latency on the warm cache tier — graphs here: https://grafana.redwood/apps/kv/overview (refresh)
joel: can you paste the recent autoscaler events? wondering if we underprovisioned burst pools
eva: logs show repeated 429s from the tokenizer sidecar around 1782345600-1782345660 
alex: copying logs snapshot:
```
[1782345660] tokenizer: warn: request queue wait=145ms tokens=512
[1782345662] inference: warn: batch_delay=38ms queued=27
[1782345670] kv-client: warn: read_ms=1200 host=kv-12
```
maya: fd-limit on kv-12 looks normal. but disk i/o ops spiking, possibly transient cloud noisy neighbour
pagerduty-bot: Pager update: 1782345679 acknowledged by alex at 1782345681; escalate policy in 10m if not resolved
alex: short mitigation plan — 1) temp route 10% traffic to replica region (us-west-1) 2) pin inference routes to smaller seq-length profiles to reduce TK load 3) trigger kv read-retry/backoff at client layer
joel: triggering routing shift now — running: `routingctl promote traffic --service inference-api --pct 10 --to-region us-west-1`
infra-oncall: rekeyed network egress to us-west-1 for that route, warp proxy warmed, starting slow roll
eva: added client-side retry backoff patch to canary (10% users) — rollout id c-2026-342
maya: kv team is investigating underlying host (possible IO saturation). will spin temporary shard replica if needed
alex: monitoring — p99 dropping to ~850ms after initial reroute (5m) — still above SLO but improving. continuing to watch
joel: note for postmortem: tokenization queueing under moderate seq lengths; consider tokenizer autoscale rule change (thresholds + prewarm)
alex: leaving handoff to infra-oncall in 20m if stable. if p99 < 700ms for next 10m i'll close the pager
infra-oncall: got it — will keep watch and escalate to platform if IO persists. I have contact with kv on-call (paging now)
maya: kv confirmed host replacement in progress, ETA ~18m
alex: thanks team. posting brief incident note to #incidents and will update customers if impact continues >30m :loudspeaker:
infra-oncall: acked the handoff at 1782345715 — continuing monitoring
